name: droidbotApp
notes: The app contains DroidBotIME, a settings activity and a commented-out patch for the PrivacyStreams accessibility service; building it requires importing the PrivacyStreams Android SDK. DroidBot's droidbot_ime.py adapter enables the service with adb ime commands.
summary: Android companion app for the DroidBot test input generator that registers an input method service; DroidBot sends text by broadcast intent over adb and the service enters it into the focused text field.
